difficulty_reason: Pseudo-coherent complexes are homotopy colimits of perfect ones: (2)=>(1) by the definitional argument on truncations (tau_{>= -n}K_n (-n+1)-pseudo-coherent for all n); (1)=>(2) by the approximation induction - pick a,b from lemma-ext-from-perfect-into-bounded-QCoh for K_n, choose the next approximation at min(a-1, -n-1), form the cone C with H^i(C) = 0 for i >= a so Hom(K_n, C) = 0, and factor K_n -> K through K_{n+1} by the representable-homological lemma; hocolim identification via the cohomology-of-hocolim lemma.
